what: Human RAVDESS joint pair-difference regression for G2 (plan section 2.2): predicted human ln(amp strong/normal) for a realised acoustic delta. Computed before any v2a training step.

predictors.d_level_db: LEVEL_DB(strong) - LEVEL_DB(normal); level_def.measure()['level_db']: median 30-ms frame dBFS (10-ms hop, 16 kHz) over the speech extent (acoustic.py span v2), frames within 40 dB of the extent max
predictors.d_register_st: 12 log2(f0_med_hz ratio); f0_med_hz = exp(median ln F0) over voiced 5-ms frames inside the speech extent, WORLD harvest analysis with the per-file constrained range (lilthead/extract_prosody.analyse + h2_prosody_probe.interp_unvoiced), as human/acoustic.py
predictors.d_env_sd_db: ENV_SD_DB(strong) - ENV_SD_DB(normal); level_def.measure()['env_sd_db']: SD of frame dB re p99 over the same frames

outcome.amp: metrics.span_pct (p95 - p5, 240-Hz linear re-grid) of the pose-normalised MediaPipe track (human/analyze.py build_signals) in window W2 = metrics.speech_mask(logE 60 fps, 30 dB) span, i.e. the window utterance_metrics uses on model outputs
outcome.brow_mean: 0.5 x (ln ratio brow_inner + ln ratio brow_outer) (plan primary endpoint)

how_to_predict.slope_only: sum_j slopes[j] * delta[j]  (plan G2 wording: coefficients x realised delta)
how_to_predict.interval: percentile over g2_boot_draws.npz[key] @ v, v = coefficient vector in coef_names order; normal approx: v' cov_boot v

primary.note: E4 = the G1 / ladder emotions; which prediction (slope-only or with intercept) and which model enter GATES.md is not decided here
